research_question: Did RCEP entry raise the probability that a covered Chinese listed firm first entered a previously unconnected RCEP supplier country relative to an Asian non-RCEP candidate country?

population.firm_universe: Valid listed six-digit tickers with at least one foreign supplier relationship active at year-end 2017.
population.risk_set_rule: Cross the frozen firms with all 21 candidate countries. Exclude a firm-country dyad if any supplier relationship to that country had first_start on or before 2017-12-31. Retain each remaining dyad through its first active year-end or through 2024 if it never enters.
population.ticker_rule: Aggregate multiple FactSet cn_ids sharing one listed ticker; exclude 000000 and tickers absent from the verified listed-firm panel.

treatment.preferred: Country-specific timing: 2022 for RCEP members except Indonesia and the Philippines, 2023 for Indonesia and the Philippines, never for Asian controls.

outcomes.primary: Indicator equal to one in the first year-end at which at least one supplier relationship to the candidate country is active, zero while still at risk, and absent after first entry.
outcomes.secondary: Count of first-time foreign supplier partner links in the candidate country-year while the country dyad is at risk.
outcomes.measurement_note: First country entry is first observed active year-end after a clean pre-2018 history, not customs-recorded import entry.

estimand: Within a listed firm-year, the differential post-entry change in first supplier-country entry probability for RCEP candidate countries relative to Asian non-RCEP candidates.

estimating_equations.static: Entry_fct = alpha_fc + lambda_ft + beta TreatedCountryTime_ct + error_fct
estimating_equations.dynamic: Cohort-by-event interactions with event time -1 omitted, firm-country and firm-year fixed effects.
estimating_equations.primary_model: Linear probability model on the discrete-time risk set.
estimating_equations.randomization_inference: Exact or 9,999 country-label assignments preserving 14 treated and 7 control countries; all draws retained.

identifying_assumption: Absent RCEP, the relative probability that the same firm entered an unconnected RCEP rather than Asian non-RCEP supplier country would have evolved similarly after controlling for firm-country fixed differences and all firm-year shocks.

data_gate.minimum_events: At least 30 first-entry events in each treatment group during 2018-2021 and at least 30 in each group during 2022-2024.
data_gate.country_support: At least five RCEP and five Asian-control countries must record one or more events in both the pre and post periods.
data_gate.overlap: At least 100 firms must contribute candidate dyads to both groups in every analysis year.
data_gate.failure_rule: If any condition fails, archive as FAILED before estimating event-study or post-treatment coefficients.

identification_gate.pretrend: Joint test of all cohort-specific leads must have p >= 0.10.
identification_gate.economic_threshold: Maximum absolute aggregated lead must not exceed max(0.0025, 0.5 times the 2018-2021 Asian-control entry rate), computed before coefficient estimation.
identification_gate.placebo: Observed post estimate must be unusual under the frozen country-label randomization distribution for positive evidence.
identification_gate.stop_rule: Failure of pretrend or economic threshold stops the run before headline, robustness, mechanism, or heterogeneity analysis.

evidence_gate.positive_result: Preferred staged effect has randomization-inference p < 0.05, the same sign under uniform timing, and is not driven by one country in leave-one-country-out estimates.
evidence_gate.null_result: If identification passes but the observed effect is ordinary under country labels, mark INCONCLUSIVE.
evidence_gate.integrity: No country, firm, year, seed, outcome, or clustering level is selected based on significance.

amendment_rule: Any change after freeze is appended to pap/amendments.md before the changed analysis is run.
